en.headline: Food safety centre orders recall of mislabelled bamboo shoots
en.dek: A prepackaged sample sold through HKTV Mall contained sulphur dioxide within the legal limit, but the label did not name the additive.
body: The Centre for Food Safety has ordered a stop-sale and recall of a batch of prepackaged bamboo shoots after a sample failed food-labelling rules.

The centre said the sample, collected from an online shop under its routine surveillance programme, contained sulphur dioxide, a preservative permitted in some foods. The level detected was within the legal limit, but the label did not state the additive's functional class or its name. The product was a 250-gram pack of Unionsum Food bamboo shoots from the mainland, with a best-before date of 2 August 2027, sold through HKTV Mall. Unionsum Food Company was named as the sole distributor.

The centre said it had told the distributor and the vendor to stop selling the affected batch and remove it from shelves. It said the distributor had started a recall. Members of the public were advised not to eat the affected batch. The centre gave a hotline, 6275 2510, for recall enquiries during office hours.

The centre reminded the trade that preservatives must comply with the Preservatives in Food Regulation. It also said the labelling rules require prepackaged food containing sulphite at 10 parts per million or more to list the sulphite's functional class and name.

zh.headline: 食安中心令預先包裝竹筍停售回收 標籤未列二氧化硫
zh.dek: 樣本經HKTV Mall出售，檢出的二氧化硫未超出法定上限，但標籤沒有標明添加劑名稱及作用類別。
body: 食物安全中心公布，一個預先包裝竹筍樣本違反食物標籤規定，已指令受影響批次停售並回收。
中心表示，樣本是在恆常食物監察計劃下從網上商店抽取。檢測發現含防腐劑二氧化硫，含量在法定上限以內，但標籤沒有標明添加劑的作用類別和名稱。涉事產品為集森食品250克裝竹筍，產地內地，此日期前最佳為2027年8月2日，經HKTV Mall發售，總經銷商為集森食品公司。
中心稱已通知總經銷商及有關商戶，停止出售受影響批次並從貨架下架，總經銷商已展開回收。中心呼籲市民不要食用受影響批次，並提供熱線6275 2510，供市民在辦公時間查詢回收事宜。
中心提醒業界，食物使用防腐劑須符合《食物內防腐劑規例》。根據標籤規例，預先包裝食物若含亞硫酸鹽達百萬分之十或以上，須在配料表列明其作用類別及名稱。
